description: A digitally rendered model of a curtain with a pleated design. The curtain is a pale blue and pink, with a soft gradient effect. It appears to be hanging from a thin, white rod. The overall impression is one of simplicity and modernity. The background is a gradient of dark grey to a muted reddish-brown, suggesting a soft, ambient lighting environment. The curtain's texture seems smooth and possibly fabric-like, though rendered with a sleek, almost plastic finish. The pleats are evenly spaced and create a visually interesting pattern of light and shadow.
